existence is scary and confusing."},{"startSec":4.019,"endSec":9.6,"text":"A few hundred thousand years ago, we became conscious and found ourselves in a strange place."},{"startSec":9.6,"endSec":14.82,"text":"It was filled with other beings. We could eat some; some could eat us."},{"startSec":14.82,"endSec":19.5,"text":"There was liquid stuff we could drink; things we could use to make more things."},{"startSec":19.5,"endSec":22.9,"text":"The daytime sky had a tiny yellow ball that warmed our skin."},{"startSec":22.9,"endSec":25.62,"text":"The night sky was filled with beautiful lights."},{"startSec":25.62,"endSec":28.1,"text":"This place was obviously made for us."},{"startSec":28.1,"endSec":29.94,"text":"Something was watching over us."},{"startSec":29.94,"endSec":35.02,"text":"We were home. This made everything much less scary and confusing."},{"startSec":35.02,"endSec":38.96,"text":"But the older we got, the more we learned about the world and ourselves."},{"startSec":38.96,"endSec":43.66,"text":"We learned that the twinkling lights are not shining beautifully for us, they just are."},{"startSec":43.66,"endSec":46.84,"text":"We learned that we're not at the center of what we now call the universe,"},{"startSec":46.84,"endSec":49.9,"text":"and that it is much, much older than we thought."},{"startSec":49.9,"endSec":52.6,"text":"We learned that we're made of many little dead things,"},{"startSec":52.6,"endSec":55.68,"text":"which make up bigger things that are not dead, for some reason,"},{"startSec":55.68,"endSec":61.38,"text":"and that we're just another temporary stage in a history going back over a billion years."},{"startSec":61.38,"endSec":66.32,"text":"We learned, in awe, that we live on a moist speck of dust moving around a medium-sized star"},{"startSec":66.32,"endSec":71.84,"text":"in a quiet region of one arm of an average galaxy, which is part of a galaxy group that we will never leave."},{"startSec":71.84,"endSec":76.72,"text":"And this group is only one of thousands that, together, make up a galaxy supercluster."},{"startSec":76.72,"endSec":82.86,"text":"But even our supercluster is only one in thousands that make up what we call the observable universe."},{"startSec":82.86,"endSec":87.58,"text":"The universe might be a million times bigger, but we will never know."},{"startSec":87.58,"endSec":90.74,"text":"We can throw words around like two hundred million galaxies"},{"startSec":90.74,"endSec":93.56,"text":"or trillions of stars or bazillions of planets,"},{"startSec":93.56,"endSec":98.24,"text":"but all of these numbers mean nothing. Our brains can't comprehend these concepts."},{"startSec":98.24,"endSec":102,"text":"The universe is too big. There is too much of it."},{"startSec":102,"endSec":105.52,"text":"But size is not the most troubling concept we have to deal with."},{"startSec":105.52,"endSec":109.38,"text":"It's time, or, more precisely, the time we have."},{"startSec":109.96,"endSec":111.96,"text":"If you're lucky enough to live to one hundred,"},{"startSec":111.96,"endSec":115.12,"text":"you have five thousand two hundred weeks at your disposal."},{"startSec":115.12,"endSec":119.96,"text":"If you're twenty-five now, then you have three thousand nine hundred weeks left."},{"startSec":119.96,"endSec":125.8,"text":"If you're going to die at seventy, then there are two thousand three hundred and forty weeks left -"},{"startSec":125.8,"endSec":128.76,"text":"a lot of time, but also ... not really."},{"startSec":129.46,"endSec":130.7,"text":"And then what?"},{"startSec":130.94,"endSec":133.74,"text":"Your biological processes will break down,"},{"startSec":133.74,"endSec":137.06,"text":"and the dynamic pattern that is you will stop beinge dynamic."},{"startSec":137.06,"endSec":140.58,"text":"It will dissolve until there is no you left."},{"startSec":140.58,"endSec":143.935,"text":"Some believe that there is a part of us we can't see or measure,"},{"startSec":143.94,"endSec":148.22,"text":"but we have no way to find out, so this life might be it"},{"startSec":148.22,"endSec":150.8,"text":"and we might end up dead forever."},{"startSec":150.8,"endSec":153.18,"text":"This is less scary than it sounds, though."},{"startSec":153.18,"endSec":157.72,"text":"If you don't remember the 13.75 billion years that went by before you existed,"},{"startSec":157.72,"endSec":163.98,"text":"Then the trillions and trillions and trillions of years that come after will pass in no time once you're gone."},{"startSec":163.98,"endSec":166.84,"text":"Close your eyes. Count to 1."},{"startSec":167.4,"endSec":169.56,"text":"That's how long forever feels."},{"startSec":169.98,"endSec":175.68,"text":"And as far as we know, in the end, the universe itself will die and nothing will ever change again."},{"startSec":176.38,"endSec":179.32,"text":"Our videos induce existential dread in many people,"},{"startSec":179.32,"endSec":181.56,"text":"and the last few minutes probably haven't helped."},{"startSec":181.88,"endSec":185.38,"text":"So, for once, we want to offer a different way of looking at these things:"},{"startSec":185.38,"endSec":190.76,"text":"an unscientific, subjective point of view, the philosophy of Kurzgesagt, if you want."},{"startSec":190.76,"endSec":195.54,"text":"Please take it with a grain of salt; we don't know any more about human existence than you do."},{"startSec":195.54,"endSec":199.78,"text":"We counter existential dread with optimistic nihilism."},{"startSec":199.78,"endSec":201.36,"text":"What do we mean by that?"},{"startSec":201.88,"endSec":208.24,"text":"Well, to summarize, it seems very unlikely that 200 trillion trillion stars have been made for us."},{"startSec":208.24,"endSec":211.98,"text":"In a way, it feels like the cruelest joke in existence has been played on us."},{"startSec":211.98,"endSec":216.44,"text":"We became self-aware only to realize this story is not about us."},{"startSec":216.44,"endSec":220,"text":"While it is great to know about electrons and the powerhouse of the cell,"},{"startSec":220,"endSec":223.2,"text":"Science doesn't do a lot to make this less depressing."},{"startSec":223.62,"endSec":225.66,"text":"Okay, but so what?"},{"startSec":225.66,"endSec":229.92,"text":"You only get one shot at life, which is scary, but it also sets you free."},{"startSec":230.28,"endSec":235.58,"text":"If the universe ends in heat death, every humiliation you suffer in your life will be forgotten."},{"startSec":235.58,"endSec":238.7,"text":"Every mistake you made will not matter in the end."},{"startSec":238.7,"endSec":241.6,"text":"Every bad thing you did will be voided."},{"startSec":241.6,"endSec":246.46,"text":"If our life is all we get to experience, then it's the only thing that matters."},{"startSec":246.46,"endSec":251.58,"text":"If the universe has no principles, the only principles relevant are the ones we decide on."},{"startSec":251.58,"endSec":256.24,"text":"If the universe has no purpose, then we get to dictate what its purpose is."},{"startSec":256.24,"endSec":260.04,"text":"Humans will most certainly cease to exist at some point,"},{"startSec":260.04,"endSec":264.56,"text":"but before we do, we get to explore ourselves and the world around us."},{"startSec":264.56,"endSec":270.96,"text":"We get to experience feelings. We get to experience food, books, sunrises, and being with each other."},{"startSec":270.96,"endSec":275.92,"text":"The fact that we're even able to think about these things is already kind of incredible."},{"startSec":275.92,"endSec":280.84,"text":"It's easy to think of ourselves as separated from everything, but this is not true."},{"startSec":280.84,"endSec":283.78,"text":"We are as much the universe as a neutron star"},{"startSec":283.78,"endSec":285.98,"text":"or a black hole or a nebula."},{"startSec":285.98,"endSec":289.455,"text":"Even better, actually, we are its thinking and feeling part:"},{"startSec":289.46,"endSec":292.06,"text":"the centre organs of the universe."},{"startSec":292.06,"endSec":295.435,"text":"We are truly free in a universe-sized playground,"},{"startSec":295.44,"endSec":300.4,"text":"so we might as well aim to be happy and to build some kind of utopia in the stars."},{"startSec":300.4,"endSec":303.4,"text":"It's not as if we've found out everything there is to know"},{"startSec":303.4,"endSec":306.14,"text":"We don't know why the rules of the universe are as they are,"},{"startSec":306.14,"endSec":309.54,"text":"how life came into existence, what life is."},{"startSec":309.54,"endSec":314.56,"text":"We have no idea what consciousness is or if we are alone in the universe."},{"startSec":314.56,"endSec":317.06,"text":"But we can try to find some answers."},{"startSec":317.54,"endSec":320.98,"text":"There are billions of stars to visit, diseases to cure,"},{"startSec":320.98,"endSec":323.92,"text":"people to help, happy feelings to be experienced,"},{"startSec":323.92,"endSec":325.9,"text":"and video games to finish."},{"startSec":325.9,"endSec":328.16,"text":"There is so much to do."},{"startSec":328.16,"endSec":332.94,"text":"So, wrapping up, you've probably used up a good chunk of the time available to you."},{"startSec":332.94,"endSec":337.04,"text":"If this is our one shot at life, there is no reason not to have fun"},{"startSec":337.04,"endSec":338.84,"text":"and live as happy as possible."},{"startSec":339.46,"endSec":342.4,"text":"Bonus points if you made the life of other people better."},{"startSec":342.4,"endSec":345.98,"text":"More bonus points if you help build a galactic human empire."},{"startSec":346.68,"endSec":349.32,"text":"Do the things that make you feel good."},{"startSec":349.32,"endSec":351.5,"text":"You get to decide whatever this means for
